name: Málaga (Colombia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above and green below, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Málaga with mantling.
history: Municipal flag of Málaga, a municipality in the department of Santander, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Málaga arms — with mantling and the mottoes HONOR and VALOR
